propositions: HmacScheme must be registered in the attest registry as a first-class scheme with name HMAC-SHA256, implementing the Scheme protocol and verifying DSSE-PAE bytes via HMAC-SHA256 with constant-time comparison.
register_legacy_schemes() must pin both plan-review and completion-verifier policy entries to the HMAC-SHA256 scheme with namespace rebar-attest-hmac, and be idempotent across multiple calls.

HmacScheme.verify must fail closed for missing/empty trust_root keys (foreign_key verdict), empty signatures lists (mismatch verdict), and non-matching signatures, while returning certified verdict for correct key verification.
Existing plan-review and completion-verifier attestation records must continue verifying unchanged via the untouched signing.py path without rerouting through the registry.
The signing.py sign and verify functions must remain unmodified and continue producing certified verdicts for existing signed manifests after this change.
